headline: Earnings jump as Williams raises guidance, expands via M&A
summary_short: Williams' Q2 2026 GAAP net income rose 51% y/y to $827 million ($0.68 diluted EPS) as revenue grew 10% y/y to $3.05 billion; the company raised its 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance midpoint by $200 million to $8.4 billion and agreed to acquire Momentum Midstream.
summary_long: Revenue was $3.05B (+9.8% y/y, +0.8% q/q) while GAAP net income rose to $827M (+51.5% y/y, -4.4% q/q) on $0.68 diluted EPS. Operating income of $1.18B was up 25.1% y/y but down 10.5% q/q. Adjusted EBITDA of $1.921B (+6% y/y) was driven by transmission and Gulf Coast expansions, higher storage revenues, and stronger gathering performance, partially offset by higher operating and administrative expenses. Cash fell to $203M from $950M at Q1-end after heavy capital investment; shareholders' equity rose 6% y/y to $13.19B. Williams raised 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance midpoint by $200M to $8.4B ($8.3-8.5B range) and growth capex to $7.3-7.9B, reflecting the pending $5.5B Momentum Midstream acquisition that expands its Haynesville gas position.
